contract: Socket.IO ereader-devices-updated: a device write that changes the email-settings row emits {ereaderDevices:[the caller's accessible devices]} to the caller's authenticated sockets only, and no repeated or rejected write emits it.
exceptions: force is not applicable: this event has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: POST /api/me/ereader-devices emits ereader-devices-updated with one argument {ereaderDevices:[...]} naming only the caller's accessible devices to the caller's sockets on every changing write (including a shortened or emptied list), to no other user's socket, and emits nothing for an unchanged list or a rejected payload; the admin POST /api/emails/ereader-devices emits the same event with the complete stored device list to every admin socket.
